description: Implementation of the DrmMetadata class managing DRM metadata, including methods for adding, retrieving, and iterating over metadata entries.

classes.name: DrmMetadata
classes.description: Class managing DRM metadata key-value pairs.

classes.name: DrmMetadata::Iterator
